title: CinePanalo hit ‘Multwoh’ gets 2nd life via Ayala Cinemas
summary: Due to overwhelming public demand, "Multwoh (Patay na Patay Sa'yo)" has announced a nationwide theatrical run, with screenings at 13 Ayala Cinemas across the country.
